directAnswer: To record your screen on an iPhone, enable the Screen Recording feature in Settings and then use the Control Center to start recording.
summary: Screen recording on iPhone is a straightforward process that requires enabling the feature in settings and accessing it through the Control Center.

sections.heading: Enabling Screen Recording
sections.body: To record your screen, first ensure that the Screen Recording feature is enabled in your iPhone settings. Go to Settings > Control Center > Customize Controls, then add Screen Recording.

sections.heading: Using Control Center to Record
sections.body: Once Screen Recording is enabled, swipe down from the upper-right corner of the screen (or swipe up from the bottom on older models) to access the Control Center. Tap the Screen Recording icon to start recording.

sections.heading: Stopping the Recording
sections.body: To stop recording, tap the red status bar at the top of the screen and select 'Stop', or return to the Control Center and tap the Screen Recording icon again.

steps.title: Enable Screen Recording
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Control Center > Customize Controls and add Screen Recording.

steps.title: Access Control Center
steps.detail: Swipe down from the upper-right corner (or swipe up from the bottom on older models) to open the Control Center.

steps.title: Start Recording
steps.detail: Tap the Screen Recording icon to begin capturing your screen.

steps.title: Stop Recording
steps.detail: Tap the red status bar at the top of the screen and select 'Stop', or tap the Screen Recording icon again in the Control Center.

faqs.question: Can I record audio while screen recording?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can record audio by long-pressing the Screen Recording icon in the Control Center and tapping the microphone icon to enable audio recording.

faqs.question: Where can I find my recorded videos?
faqs.answer: Your screen recordings are saved to the Photos app in the 'Recents' album.

faqs.question: Is there a time limit for screen recording?
faqs.answer: There is no specific time limit for screen recording, but storage space on your device may affect the duration of your recordings.

caveats: Screen recording may not capture certain apps or content due to copyright restrictions.
